A central metal ring mechanism (appearing to be a 2-ring or 4-ring style, though partially obscured by glare) runs vertically down the spine. There are pockets on the lower half of both the left and right inner covers.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal corner pieces have a slightly unnatural, uniform yellowish-green tint and lack realistic specular highlights or scratches expected from brass or gold-plated metal. They look somewhat like rendered plastic.

The reflection on the central metal bar is extremely vertical and sharp, contrasting with the softer lighting on the rest of the object. It looks slightly like a digital artifact or 'smear' rather than a natural reflection.
The edge of the clear plastic pocket on the right side blends slightly into the black background material without a distinct boundary line, suggesting minor segmentation or blending issues.
